conditions.scenario: fresh profile, #upload, no work order or uploaded images
conditions.cache: new profile and cleared browser cache for every run; normal cache behavior during navigation
conditions.externalNetwork: cdnjs pinned versions fulfilled from local vendor; other HTTPS blocked; any unmapped external request invalidates the run; loopback HTTP is not intercepted
conditions.readyCondition: document complete + 107 registered blocks + view-upload + initial loading hidden; 50ms observation interval
conditions.baseline: tmp/perf-baseline snapshot first; other files fall back to current root
limitations: Not weak-machine simulation or GitHub Pages transfer timing
Uncompressed loopback bytes differ from server gzip/brotli transfer
Resource Timing sizes are browser-known values; zero is not proof of cache hit
App-ready timing is observed with up to about 50ms polling granularity
Snapshot does not duplicate every unchanged binary asset
